fact: Many decisions are thought to arise from the accumulation of noisy evidence until a certain threshold is reached.
source_span: Many decisions are thought to arise via the accumulation of noisy evidence to a threshold or bound . The decision terminates when the accumulated evidence for one alternative , termed a decision variable ( DV ) , reaches a threshold or bound , thereby determining both the choice and the decision time .
abstract_sentence: Many decisions are thought to arise via the accumulation of noisy evidence to a threshold or bound.

fact: The bounded evidence accumulation theory predicts that an increase in noise should lead to faster decisions, reduced accuracy, and paradoxically, higher confidence.
source_span: An increase in noise should lead to faster decisions , reduced accuracy and , paradoxically , higher confidence . The important point is that by increasing noise , the volatility manipulation accelerates the dispersion of the decision variable away from its expected value and nearer the termination bounds , hence faster RT . Increased volatility should affect confidence because it mimics an increase in the diffusion rate .
abstract_sentence: An increase in noise should lead to faster decisions, reduced accuracy and, paradoxically, higher confidence.

fact: The researchers developed a novel sensory manipulation to mimic unbiased noise in motion-selective visual cortex regions, which was verified by neuronal recordings in macaque areas MT/MST.
source_span: To test these predictions , we introduce a novel sensory manipulation that mimics the addition of unbiased noise to motion-selective regions of visual cortex, which we verified with neuronal recordings from macaque areas MT/MST . To test these predictions , we introduce a novel sensory manipulation that mimics the addition of unbiased noise to motion-selective regions of visual cortex , which we verified with neuronal recordings from macaque areas MT/MST . We achieved this with a manipulation of the motion information in a random dot motion ( RDM ) display , by adding a second level of randomness which increased its volatility but was unbiased with respect to the strength and direction of motion evidence . We verified that the manipulation has the desired properties by recording from direction selective neurons in the middle temporal ( MT ) and medial superior temporal ( MST ) areas of the macaque visual cortex .
abstract_sentence: To test these predictions, we introduce a novel sensory manipulation that mimics the addition of unbiased noise to motion-selective regions of visual cortex, which we verified with neuronal recordings from macaque areas MT/MST.

fact: In both humans and monkeys, increased noise led to faster decisions and greater confidence, with only minimal impairment to accuracy.
source_span: For both humans and monkeys , increasing the noise induced faster decisions and greater confidence over a range of stimuli for which accuracy was minimally impaired . The main effect of high volatility was to decrease RTs , particularly at the weakest motion strengths ( Figure 3B , bottom row , red ) . The manipulation affected the accuracy only subtly , and this was not statistically reliable for individual subjects in the RT task ( Figure 3B , top row; for the four subjects: p=[0 . 35 , 0 . 65 , 0 . 2 , 0 . 26] , Equation 17 , likelihood-ratio test ) .
abstract_sentence: For both humans and monkeys, increasing the noise induced faster decisions and greater confidence over a range of stimuli for which accuracy was minimally impaired.

fact: The observed effects of increased noise on decision speed and confidence were consistent with the predictions of a bounded evidence accumulation model.
source_span: The magnitude of the effects was in agreement with predictions of a bounded evidence accumulation model . The overall quality of the fits—across all tasks and both species—indicates that the influence of motion strength and volatility on choice , reaction time and confidence can be explained by a common mechanism of bounded evidence accumulation . and ( iii ) showed how a framework based on the bounded accumulation of evidence can account for the joint effect of volatility on choice , reaction time and confidence .
abstract_sentence: The magnitude of the effects was in agreement with predictions of a bounded evidence accumulation model.

fact: Working memory (WM) is an emergent property of large-scale network interactions in the brain.
source_span: Cognitive functions such as working memory ( WM ) are emergent properties of large-scale network interactions . Cognitive processes depend on coordinated interactions among large-scale distributed brain networks .
abstract_sentence: Cognitive functions like working memory (WM) emerge from large-scale network interactions.

fact: Synchronisation of oscillatory activity in the brain might contribute to working memory by enabling the coordination of long-range processes.
source_span: Synchronisation of oscillatory activity might contribute to WM by enabling the coordination of long-range processes . Rhythmic synchrony increases network efficiency , a process thought to be particularly relevant for demanding cognitive processes such as working memory ( WM )
abstract_sentence: Synchronisation of oscillatory activity may contribute to WM by coordinating long-range processes.

fact: Transcranial alternating current stimulation (tACS) was used to exogenously modulate oscillatory activity in a right frontoparietal network that supports working memory.
source_span: Here we applied transcranial alternating current stimulation ( tACS ) to exogenously modulate oscillatory activity in a right frontoparietal network that supports WM . In- and anti-phase theta frequency ( 6 Hz ) stimulation was applied across two key nodes of the right frontoparietal network: the middle frontal gyrus and inferior parietal lobule . Theta (6 Hz) tACS was applied to the middle frontal gyrus and inferior parietal lobule nodes (center electrode locations at F4 and P4) of the frontoparietal network in synchronous (0° relative phase) and desynchronous (180° relative phase) conditions.
abstract_sentence: Transcranial alternating current stimulation (tACS) was used to modulate oscillatory activity in a right frontoparietal network supporting WM.

fact: Externally induced synchronization improved working memory performance when cognitive demands were high.
source_span: Externally induced synchronization improved performance when cognitive demands were high . We found that synchronous ( in-phase ) stimulation caused an improvement in performance and led to increased frontoparietal activity when cognitive demands were high . Synchronous tACS improved reaction times (RTs) for the more demanding 2-back condition compared both to desynchronous tACS and sham.
abstract_sentence: Externally induced synchronization improved performance when cognitive demands were high.

fact: Simultaneously collected fMRI data revealed that tACS effects were dependent on the relative phase of the stimulation and the internal cognitive processing state.
source_span: Simultaneously collected fMRI data reveals tACS effects dependent on the relative phase of the stimulation and the internal cognitive processing state . The effects depend on the relative phase of the external oscillators and also the underlying cognitive state at the time tACS is applied . Our imaging results for the 2-back and CRT tasks strongly support these notions and show how the physiological effect of external oscillatory manipulations are highly dependent on the underlying cognitive state .
abstract_sentence: Simultaneously collected fMRI data revealed tACS effects dependent on stimulation phase and cognitive state.

fact: Synchronous tACS during a verbal working memory task increased parietal activity, which correlated with behavioral performance.
source_span: Specifically , synchronous tACS during the verbal WM task increased parietal activity , which correlated with behavioral performance . In particular , we showed that imposing theta frequency synchronously across the inferior parietal lobe and middle frontal gyrus improves verbal WM performance and increases frontal and parietal brain activity . In keeping with these findings , we show that increased activity within the right inferior parietal lobe correlated with faster responses during the 2-back , supporting a link between neural activity and the behavioral effects of tACS .
abstract_sentence: Synchronous tACS during a verbal WM task increased parietal activity, correlating with performance.

fact: Functional connectivity results indicate that the relative phase of frontoparietal stimulation influences information flow within the working memory network.
source_span: Furthermore , functional connectivity results indicate that the relative phase of frontoparietal stimulation influences information flow within the WM network . Frontal interactions increased with synchronous theta stimulation whereas posterior interactions increased with desynchronous stimulation , suggesting that information flow through brain regions involved in WM can be differentially affected by varying the phase of external stimulation . The functional connectivity of the inferior parietal lobe was also modulated by tACS in a phase dependent manner .
abstract_sentence: Functional connectivity results indicate that the relative phase of frontoparietal stimulation influences information flow within the WM network.

fact: The study's findings demonstrate a link between behavioral performance in a demanding working memory task and large-scale brain synchronization.
source_span: Overall , our findings demonstrate a link between behavioral performance in a demanding WM task and large-scale brain synchronization . Overall , our findings indicate a direct link between behavioral performance in a demanding working-memory task and large-scale brain synchronization across a right frontoparietal network activated by the task . Therefore , we provide a direct demonstration of the role of phase synchronization in cognitive demanding WM processes and we showed the neural correlates associated with this process .
abstract_sentence: Overall, findings demonstrate a link between behavioral performance in a demanding WM task and large-scale brain synchronization.

fact: The anterior thalamus and dorsal subiculum, which provide spatial information, strongly and selectively activate low-rheobase (LR) pyramidal cells in the RSG.
source_span: The anterior thalamus and dorsal subiculum , sources of spatial information , strongly and selectively recruit small low-rheobase ( LR ) pyramidal cells in RSG . Specifically , we find that anterior thalamus and dorsal subiculum preferentially control LR neurons , whereas claustrum and anterior cingulate control RS cells . This suggests that LR neurons , rather than layer 3 or 5 RS neurons , are the predominant RSG cell type receiving and processing head direction inputs from the anterior thalamus .
abstract_sentence: The anterior thalamus and dorsal subiculum, sources of spatial information, strongly and selectively recruit small low-rheobase (LR) pyramidal cells in RSG.

fact: The precise arrangement of axons and dendrites within layer 1 of the RSG enables this parallel processing of different inputs.
source_span: Precise sublaminar axonal and dendritic arborization within RSG layer 1 , in particular , permits this parallel processing . This again indicates that parallel circuits in RSG process TC versus ClaC and CC information, and this parallel processing is enabled by precise sublaminar organization of afferent axons and layer three principal cell apical dendrites. Taken together , these axon-axon , dendrite-dendrite , and axon-dendrite correlations indicate that precise , fine-grained laminar organization of LR and RS dendrites and afferent axons creates a parallel circuit in which LR neurons are selectively optimized to integrate incoming spatial information ( Figure 6D ) .

fact: Arabidopsis thaliana flowers consistently have four petals.
source_span: Petal number , for example , is invariant in Arabidopsis thaliana flowers . Petal number is invariant among natural accessions of A . thaliana , reflecting its robustness to genetic variation . This phenotype is robust to natural genetic variation; for example , flowers from genetically diverse A . thaliana accessions consistently produce four petals ( Figure 1a ) .
abstract_sentence: Petal number is invariant in Arabidopsis thaliana flowers.

fact: The closely related species Cardamine hirsuta exhibits variation in petal number.
source_span: However , petal number varies in the closely related species Cardamine hirsuta , and the genetic basis for this difference between species is unknown . Instead , C . hirsuta flowers display a variable number of petals , between zero and four , on a single plant ( Monniaux et al . , 2016; Pieper et al . , 2016 ) . fact: Divergence in the floral regulator APETALA1 (AP1) explains the species-specific difference in petal number robustness.
source_span: Here we show that divergence in the pleiotropic floral regulator APETALA1 ( AP1 ) can account for the species-specific difference in petal number robustness . In this study , we identified AP1 as a gene of major effect in the evolutionary transition from a robust phenotype of four petals , typified by A . thaliana , to a variable petal number in C . hirsuta . We found that AP1 genes from A . thaliana and C . hirsuta diverged in their ability to specify an invariant number of four petals .
abstract_sentence: Divergence in the pleiotropic floral regulator APETALA1 (AP1) can account for the species-specific difference in petal number robustness.

fact: Arabidopsis thaliana APETALA1 (AP1) confers robustness by masking the phenotypic expression of quantitative trait loci (QTL) that control petal number in Cardamine hirsuta.
source_span: A . thaliana AP1 confers robustness by masking the phenotypic expression of quantitative trait loci controlling petal number in C . hirsuta . We mapped this natural variation to specific QTL in the C . hirsuta genome and showed that introducing the A . thaliana AP1 locus masked the effects of all QTL . Therefore , petal number was effectively canalized in C . hirsuta via epistasis of A . thaliana AP1 over existing QTL . We found that this transgene was sufficient to convert C . hirsuta petal number from variable to robust , elevating petal number towards the A . thaliana value of four petals ( pairwise Mann-Whitney U test with Bonferroni correction , p=2 . 4e-08; Figure 3a , d , e ) .
abstract_sentence: This large effect of AP1 is explained by epistatic interactions: A. thaliana AP1 confers robustness by masking the phenotypic expression of quantitative trait loci controlling petal number in C. hirsuta.

fact: Cardamine hirsuta APETALA1 (AP1) fails to complement the function of Arabidopsis thaliana AP1, leading to variable petal number.
source_span: We show that C . hirsuta AP1 fails to complement this function of A . thaliana AP1 , conferring variable petal number , and that upstream regulatory regions of AP1 contribute to this divergence . We show that C . hirsuta AP1 fails to complement this function of A . thaliana AP1 , conferring variable petal number , and that upstream regulatory regions of AP1 contribute to this divergence . Therefore, functional differences in AP1 that are responsible for petal number variation between A. thaliana and C. hirsuta, are more likely to reside in regulatory regions of the gene rather than coding sequences.
abstract_sentence: C. hirsuta AP1 fails to complement this function of A. thaliana AP1, conferring variable petal number, and that upstream regulatory regions of AP1 contribute to this divergence.

fact: Variable petal number persists in Cardamine hirsuta despite sufficient genetic variation in natural populations to produce four-petalled flowers.
source_span: Moreover , variable petal number is maintained in C . hirsuta despite sufficient standing genetic variation in natural accessions to produce plants with four-petalled flowers . This shows that there is sufficient standing genetic variation to produce phenotypes through recombination that are not observed in natural accessions. Thus , the distribution of allelic effects found in natural populations of C . hirsuta is more likely to maintain variation , rather than robustness , in petal number .
abstract_sentence: Variable petal number is maintained in C. hirsuta despite sufficient standing genetic variation in natural accessions to produce plants with four-petalled flowers.

fact: The Dominican Republic experienced a Zika virus epidemic shortly after a large dengue epidemic, offering an opportunity to study transmission drivers of these two flaviviruses.
source_span: In Dominican Republic , the appearance of Zika virus cases that closely followed a large dengue epidemic provided an opportunity to study the different transmission drivers behind these two flaviviruses . The Dominican Republic was similarly affected . In 2015/early-2016 , a major dengue outbreak affected the island resulting in 17 , 324 cases in 2015 ( 18 . 0 per 10 , 000 population ) and 6329 ( 6 . 6 per 10 , 000 population ) in 2016 . As this outbreak abated , the first cases of Zika were detected .
abstract_sentence: The Dominican Republic experienced a Zika virus epidemic shortly after a large dengue epidemic, providing an opportunity to study the different transmission drivers of these two flaviviruses.

fact: Retrospective datasets were used to gather information on at-risk populations.
source_span: Retrospective datasets were used to collect information on the populations at risk and descriptive statistics were used to describe the outbreaks on a national scale . Accordingly , using a retrospective disease surveillance dataset , this study sought to: 1 ) identify and describe the transmission dynamics of Zika and dengue across Dominican Republic including associated cases of Guillain-Barre syndrome ( GBS ) , 2 ) compare the age and sex-adjusted distributions of both Zika and dengue outbreaks and 3 ) calculate the reproductive number ( R0 ) of each outbreak .
abstract_sentence: Retrospective datasets were used to collect information on populations at risk, and descriptive statistics were used to describe the outbreaks on a national scale.

abstract_sentence: 75% of dengue cases were reported in individuals under 20 years old, while Zika infections were more widely dispersed among the population.

fact: Media campaigns and screening are recommended for women of reproductive age during Zika outbreaks.
source_span: Media campaigns and screening are therefore recommended for women of reproductive age during Zika outbreaks . If correct , targeted advocacy campaigns are effective at changing short-term behaviour and are recommended during Zika epidemics .
abstract_sentence: Media campaigns and screening are therefore recommended for women of reproductive age during Zika outbreaks.

fact: Under nitrogen deprivation, filaments of the cyanobacterium Anabaena develop into a pattern of nitrogen-fixing heterocysts separated by about ten photosynthetic vegetative cells.
source_span: Under nitrogen deprivation , filaments of the cyanobacterium Anabaena undergo a process of development , resulting in a one-dimensional pattern of nitrogen-fixing heterocysts separated by about ten photosynthetic vegetative cells .
abstract_sentence: Under nitrogen deprivation, Anabaena filaments develop into a pattern of nitrogen-fixing heterocysts separated by photosynthetic vegetative cells.

fact: The coupling of gene expression fluctuations between cells along a multicellular filament in Anabaena is unknown.
source_span: Furthermore , the coupling of gene expression fluctuations between cells along a multicellular filament is unknown .
abstract_sentence: The coupling of gene expression fluctuations between cells along a multicellular filament is unknown.

fact: The study investigated the statistics of fluctuations of HetR gene expression in Anabaena, a transcription factor essential for heterocyst differentiation, using a chromosomally-encoded translational hetR-gfp fusion.
source_span: We studied the statistics of fluctuations of gene expression of HetR , a transcription factor essential for heterocyst differentiation , both under steady-state growth in nitrogen-rich conditions and at different times following nitrogen deprivation , using a chromosomally-encoded translational hetR-gfp fusion . As a reporter , a fusion to a fragment of the N-terminal part of the protein was constructed rather than a traditional transcriptional fusion because with the N-terminal translational fusion , expression of the gene with all its transcription and translation start signals is tested .
abstract_sentence: The study investigated fluctuations of HetR gene expression, a transcription factor essential for heterocyst differentiation, using a chromosomally-encoded translational hetR-gfp fusion.

fact: Expression fluctuations of hetR in nearby cells of Anabaena are coupled, with a characteristic spatial range of about two to three cells.
source_span: Statistical analysis of fluorescence at the individual cell level in wild-type and mutant filaments demonstrates that expression fluctuations of hetR in nearby cells are coupled , with a characteristic spatial range of circa two to three cells , setting the scale for cellular interactions along a filament . These correlations extend to two to three cells , setting the scale for cellular interactions along a filament .
abstract_sentence: Expression fluctuations of hetR in nearby cells are coupled, with a characteristic spatial range of about two to three cells.

fact: Correlations between cells in Anabaena filaments predominantly arise from intercellular molecular transfer, and less from cell division.
source_span: Correlations between cells predominantly arise from intercellular molecular transfer and less from cell division . We stress that the dominant part of the observed correlations must derive from intercellular molecular transfer: had the measured correlations been due exclusively to cell division , there would be no difference between the autocorrelation functions pertaining to the different mutant strains .
abstract_sentence: Correlations between cells predominantly arise from intercellular molecular transfer and less from cell division.

fact: Fluctuations in hetR expression after nitrogen step-down can build up on those under nitrogen-replete conditions.
source_span: This suggests that there is continuity between the two , and fluctuations found once the developmental network has been triggered , build up from those under nitrogen-rich conditions . Our results show that fluctuations can build up from an underlying pattern of expression under nitrogen-replete conditions in which important regulators are already expressed , and evolve to intermediate states in which fluctuations are positively correlated in clusters of cells .
abstract_sentence: Fluctuations after nitrogen step-down can build up on those under nitrogen-replete conditions.

fact: Under nitrogen-rich conditions, basal, steady-state expression of the HetR inhibitor PatS, cell-cell communication influenced by the septal protein SepJ, and positive HetR auto-regulation are essential determinants of fluctuations in hetR expression and its distribution along Anabaena filaments.
source_span: We found that under nitrogen-rich conditions , basal , steady-state expression of the HetR inhibitor PatS , cell-cell communication influenced by the septal protein SepJ and positive HetR auto-regulation are essential determinants of fluctuations in hetR expression and its distribution along filaments . Together , these facts highlight again the fundamental role that the PatS inhibitor plays in determining the fluctuations along a filament . These results can be accounted for by an attribute of HetR , namely auto-regulation , a mechanism that enhances fluctuations [47 , 48] , which is known to operate under nitrogen deprivation [22] .
abstract_sentence: Under nitrogen-rich conditions, basal expression of the HetR inhibitor PatS, cell-cell communication influenced by SepJ, and positive HetR auto-regulation are essential determinants of hetR expression fluctuations.

fact: The study's results show that proteins involved in activation, inhibition, and cell-cell communication combine with stochasticity in gene expression to control coupled fluctuations that lead to a one-dimensional developmental pattern in Anabaena.
source_span: Our results show that proteins involved in these basic ingredients combine together in the presence of inevitable stochasticity in gene expression , to control the coupled fluctuations of gene expression that give rise to a one-dimensional developmental pattern in this organism . Therefore , expression fluctuations are key determinants in the decision of cells whether to differentiate or not , together with other factors such as cell division and biased inheritance of specific factors [51] , as well as the marked tendency for heterocysts to form at the ends of finite filaments , thereby imposing a strong constraint on the phase of the patterns that form .
abstract_sentence: Proteins involved in activation, inhibition, and cell-cell communication combine with stochasticity in gene expression to control coupled fluctuations that lead to a one-dimensional developmental pattern in Anabaena.

fact: Little is known about how associative learning between a cue and a required visuomotor mapping generalizes to novel but similar conditions.
source_span: However , little is known about the associative learning between cue and required visuomotor mapping , and how learning generalises to novel but similar conditions . In this case , testing conditions cannot go beyond the specifically trained pairings to see how the trained pairings generalise to novel conditions ( a cue cannot be half present ) . The question arises how learning for a discrete number of trained pairings affects the learning rate and generalises to novel conditions on the same continuous cue scale .
abstract_sentence: Little is known about the associative learning between cue and required visuomotor mapping, and how learning generalises to novel but similar conditions.

fact: Participants performed a rapid target-pointing task where the offset between visual feedback and movement end-points was manipulated.
source_span: To investigate these questions , participants performed a rapid target-pointing task while we manipulated the offset between visual feedback and movement end-points . Participants performed a target-pointing task in which we manipulated the spatial mapping of the visual feedback that participants received upon completion of their pointing movements. This corresponds to changes occurring in the environment affecting the visuomotor mapping, such as when wearing optical glasses.
abstract_sentence: To investigate these questions, participants performed a rapid target-pointing task while we manipulated the offset between visual feedback and movement end-points.

fact: The visual feedback had horizontal offsets that varied based on the target's shape.
source_span: The visual feedback was presented with horizontal offsets of different amounts , dependent on the targets shape . For simplicity , we chose to manipulate the feedback in only the horizontal direction .
abstract_sentence: The visual feedback was presented with horizontal offsets of different amounts, dependent on the targets shape.

fact: The target shapes were part of a continuous set, morphed between spiky and circular forms.
source_span: The target shapes were taken from a continuous set of shapes , morphed between spiky and circular shapes . Here , we chose target shape as the contextual cue that ranged from circular to spiky on a continuous scale ( see Fig . 1 , cf 3 ) . The novelty of the current study is that both the shape cue and the visuomotor mappings varied in a continuous manner and the training was focussed on learning a functional relationship between the shape and the corresponding mapping—here a linear relationship.
abstract_sentence: The target shapes were taken from a continuous set of shapes, morphed between spiky and circular shapes.

fact: After training, participants' performance was tested on novel target shapes, without feedback.
source_span: After training we tested participants performance , without feedback , on different target shapes that had not been learned previously . We trained participants on only a subset of shape/visuomotor-mapping pairs and after training we tested for generalisation to other target shapes along the shape scale . Afterwards, using catch trials for which the task-relevant visual feedback was eliminated, we tested participants’ pointing performance to target shapes that had not been used explicitly during training.
abstract_sentence: After training we tested participants performance, without feedback, on different target shapes that had not been learned previously.

fact: Learning the associations required explicit awareness of the cues' role, and participants applied the visuomotor mapping of the trained shape most similar to the current one, consistent with the Bayesian learning model.
source_span: The experimental results show that , although learning the associations requires explicit awareness of the cues’ role , participants apply the mapping corresponding to the trained shape that is most similar to the current one , consistent with the Bayesian learning model . For learning to occur , participants needed to be aware of the role that the shape-cue was playing . To summarize , when confronted with a new continuous correlation between a previously irrelevant shape cue and the necessary visuomotor mapping in order to hit the target , learning of this correlation does not occur automatically but rather awareness of the correlation seems necessary to learn .
abstract_sentence: The experimental results show that, although learning the associations requires explicit awareness of the cues’ role, participants apply the mapping corresponding to the trained shape that is most similar to the current one, consistent with the Bayesian learning model.

fact: The Bayesian learning model predicted that learning would slow down with more training pairs, a prediction confirmed by the experimental results.
source_span: Furthermore , the Bayesian learning model predicts that learning should slow down with increased numbers of training pairs , which was confirmed by the present results . When multiple pairs need to be learned simultaneously , these will interfere with each other due to the generalisation of local learning . The model therefore predicts a slow down of the overall learning rate with an increased number of shape-mapping pairs to be learned . Furthermore, the Mixture-of-Kalman-Filters predicts slower learning rates with an increased number of training pairs as was also observed experimentally.
abstract_sentence: Furthermore, the Bayesian learning model predicts that learning should slow down with increased numbers of training pairs, which was confirmed by the present results.

fact: The good correspondence between the Bayesian learning model and empirical results suggests it provides a possible mechanism for simultaneously learning multiple visuomotor mappings.
source_span: In short , we found a good correspondence between the Bayesian learning model and the empirical results indicating that this model poses a possible mechanism for simultaneously learning multiple visuomotor mappings .
abstract_sentence: In short, we found a good correspondence between the Bayesian learning model and the empirical results indicating that this model poses a possible mechanism for simultaneously learning multiple visuomotor mappings.

fact: Many countries where neglected tropical diseases (NTDs) are common cannot start or expand programs because they lack basic data for planning and advocacy.
source_span: However, many NTD-endemic countries have not been able to launch or scale-up programs because they lack the necessary baseline data for planning and advocacy. resource constraints in endemic countries have impeded progress toward these goals
abstract_sentence: Many NTD-endemic countries have not been able to launch or scale-up programs because they lack the necessary baseline data for planning and advocacy.

fact: An integrated mapping approach for neglected tropical diseases (NTDs) could save significant resources where these diseases geographically overlap.
source_span: Where geographic overlap among NTDs exists, an integrated mapping approach could result in significant resource savings. Because NTDs tend to overlap in geographic areas, it is logical that an integrated approach to mapping NTDs might result in more efficient identification of populations needing treatment
abstract_sentence: Where geographic overlap among NTDs exists, an integrated mapping approach could result in significant resource savings.

fact: Researchers developed and field-tested an innovative integrated neglected tropical disease (NTD) mapping protocol called Integrated Threshold Mapping (ITM) Methodology.
source_span: We developed and field-tested an innovative integrated NTD mapping protocol (Integrated Threshold Mapping (ITM) Methodology) for lymphatic filariasis (LF), trachoma, schistosomiasis and soil-transmitted helminths (STH).
abstract_sentence: We developed and field-tested an innovative integrated NTD mapping protocol (Integrated Threshold Mapping (ITM) Methodology) for lymphatic filariasis (LF), trachoma, schistosomiasis and soil-transmitted helminths (STH).

fact: The specific purpose of the Integrated Threshold Mapping (ITM) protocol is to determine if a disease threshold to trigger public health interventions has been reached in an implementation unit.
source_span: The protocol is designed to be resource-efficient, and its specific purpose is to determine whether a threshold to trigger public health interventions in an implementation unit has been attained. Our methodology does not provide prevalence figures, its intended purpose is to determine whether a disease has attained the threshold for public health intervention by attempting to balance epidemiologic rigor and field practicality.
abstract_sentence: The protocol is designed to be resource-efficient, and its specific purpose is to determine whether a threshold to trigger public health interventions in an implementation unit has been attained.

fact: Researchers tested the Integrated Threshold Mapping (ITM) protocol by comparing it to current World Health Organization (WHO) mapping methodologies for lymphatic filariasis (LF), trachoma, schistosomiasis, and soil-transmitted helminths (STH).
source_span: We tested the protocol by comparing it to current WHO mapping methodologies for each of the targeted diseases in one district each in Mali and Senegal. The ITM protocol has been field tested in one district in each of two countries by comparing the ITM methodology to the standard disease-specific WHO mapping methodologies.
abstract_sentence: We tested the protocol by comparing it to current WHO mapping methodologies for each of the targeted diseases in one district each in Mali and Senegal.

fact: The Integrated Threshold Mapping (ITM) methodology reached the same conclusions as World Health Organization (WHO) methodologies regarding the initiation of public health interventions for trachoma, lymphatic filariasis (LF), and soil-transmitted helminths (STH).
source_span: In this study, the ITM methodology reached the same conclusions as the WHO methodologies regarding the initiation of public health interventions for trachoma, LF and STH, but resulted in more targeted intervention recommendations for schistosomiasis. In this study, the ITM methodology reached the same conclusions as the WHO methodologies regarding the initiation of public health interventions for trachoma, LF and STH, but resulted in more targeted intervention recommendations for schistosomiasis.
abstract_sentence: In this study, the ITM methodology reached the same conclusions as the WHO methodologies regarding the initiation of public health interventions for trachoma, LF and STH, but resulted in more targeted intervention recommendations for schistosomiasis.

fact: The Integrated Threshold Mapping (ITM) methodology was practical, feasible, and demonstrated overall cost savings compared to standard, non-integrated World Health Organization (WHO) methodologies.
source_span: ITM was practical, feasible and demonstrated an overall cost saving compared with the standard, non-integrated, WHO methodologies. the ITM methodology resulted in a 31% overall cost savings in Mali a 19% overall cost savings in Senegal
abstract_sentence: ITM was practical, feasible and demonstrated an overall cost saving compared with the standard, non-integrated, WHO methodologies.

fact: This integrated mapping tool could help implement much-needed neglected tropical disease (NTD) programs in endemic countries.
source_span: This integrated mapping tool could facilitate the implementation of much-needed programs in endemic countries. We describe an integrated NTD mapping methodology ( Integrated Threshold Mapping ) that can be used as an operational tool by Ministries of Health in NTD-endemic countries to determine if the threshold needed to launch disease-specific public health intervenions has been reached .
abstract_sentence: This integrated mapping tool could facilitate the implementation of much-needed programs in endemic countries.
